title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Paying back the source set check
summary: Recognising build variant test source sets had made the path check three times slower. A full pass over a real project of 5088 files fell from 26.1 ms to 9.9 ms, with the same answer.

highlights.title: The path check stops allocating
highlights.description: It split the setting and the whole path into components on every call, for every configured segment. Each setting is now parsed once, and only the few `src` positions of the path are walked.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Measured over the 5088 files of a real Android project: a full pass fell from 26.1 ms to 9.9 ms, and against the release before variant support it is 17 percent slower rather than 209 percent.
The rewrite was checked against the previous one over 94 440 combinations of real path and setting, with no difference in the answer.
